svg.title: JJ — a work constellation
svg.desc: A personal work map linking JJ to high-level StackAI work and four public projects. The orbit has one segment for each week of publicly visible GitHub activity; brighter, thicker segments indicate more contributions. Project connections are thematic, not dependencies.

g.text: A map of what I build.
Agents, data, and the systems behind them.
Orbit: one week per segment · brighter = more contributions
